title: Discount Calculator
h1: Discount Calculator — Sale Price and Savings
seoTitle: Free Discount Calculator — Percentage Off Online
description: Calculate the final price after a percentage discount. Also shows the amount saved. Useful for shopping, sales and invoices.
intro: Enter the original price and the discount percentage. Instantly see the sale price and how much you save.
blurb: Find the final price and savings after a percentage discount.
howItWorks: Type the original price and the discount percentage.
The tool subtracts the discount amount from the original price.
You see the final price and the exact amount saved.
examples: A ₹1,000 item with 20% off costs ₹800; you save ₹200.
